title: Can the 16-channel VHE model overfit a fixed 8-pair batch with a proper step budget?
hypothesis: EXP-0025 arm A only reached 0.913x the initial loss in 60 steps at lr 3e-4, which is too few updates to tell whether the model can fit at all. With lr 3e-3 and 600 steps on the same fixed batch of 8 cached pairs, the total humanization loss falls to at most 0.4x its first value with no NaN and unchanged output length.
notes: lr 3e-3, 600 steps on the same fixed 8 pairs. Reached 0.530x of the first total, short of the preregistered 0.4x; all loss terms were still decreasing at step 600, so the budget, not capacity, was binding. log_magnitude remained 1.52 of total 1.98 (77%). GPU peak memory not recorded. No listening test.
